newsitem.title: UK: Royal Sun firm after Goldman Sachs upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Royal Sun firm after Goldman Sachs upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc gathered strength on Wednesday after analysts at Goldman Sachs moved the stock to "buy" from "hold".
The shares were up 12p to 465p by 1127 GMT in volume of 2.3 million.
Analyst Stephen Dias said Royal Sun was his favourite in the sector. He noted that the shares had fallen back from a "fair" price of 510p to 450p recently.
He maintains a share price target of 500p but thinks the stock may still outperform the market if that short-term target is reached.
"We think it's going to be a good year for Royal Sun," Dias said. "With very good first quarter results and cost savings next year, we like the momentum in the company."
